title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Trump Admin Proposes $103K H-1B Visa Fee: Polymarket reports an executive proposal to increase new H-1B application fees to $103,265, up from typical $2K–$5K ranges.
Anthropic Prepares Opus 5.1 & Sonnet 5.1 Release: Bindu Reddy shared upcoming Anthropic model rollout plans designed to resolve recent prompt regressions.
Open-Source 1.6T LongCat 2.0 Released: OpenCode launched LongCat-2.0 in Go featuring a 1M token context window and open model weights.
Decentralized Qwen Node Economics: Tech creators detail local Apple Silicon hardware math showing used M1 Pro chips generating $150/mo serving Qwen inference.
Domestic AI Accelerator Fabrication Progress: The Economist evaluates reports of Chinese semiconductor breakthroughs aimed at mass-producing AI chips.

items.title: @Polymarket: Trump Administration Moves to Impose $103K Fee on H-1B Visas
items.body: The Trump administration has proposed raising fees on new H-1B worker visas to $103,265 (up from $2,000–$5,000), sparking widespread debate across the technology and AI research sector.

items.title: @bindureddy: Anthropic Preparing Opus 5.1 & Sonnet 5.1 Releases
items.body: Multiple new Anthropic models (Opus 5.1, Sonnet 5.1, and Fable 5.1) are set to launch shortly, addressing model regressions and improving long-context task performance.

items.title: @opencode: OpenCode Releases LongCat-2.0 in Go
items.body: OpenCode released LongCat-2.0, a 1.6T/48B MoE open-weights model supporting a 1 million token context window natively in Go.

items.title: @rickmanelius: Economics of Serving Qwen Locally on Used Mac Hardware
items.body: Hardware tech breakdown shows how a used Apple M1 Pro (32GB) purchased for $900 can generate ~$150/month serving Qwen model inference locally.

items.title: @Saboo_Shubham_: Gemini 3.7 Flash Tops Benchmarks on Artificial Analysis
items.body: Artificial Analysis benchmarks show Gemini 3.7 Flash outperforming rival models across agentic evaluation tasks.

items.title: @GoSailGlobal: Zoetrope Visualizer for Claude Code Workflows
items.body: Developers released Zoetrope, an open-source terminal visualization tool that graphs Claude Code agent executions, tool calls, and subagent trees in real time.

items.title: @TheEconomist: China's Advanced AI Semiconductor Scaling
items.body: Economic analysis details Chinese domestic semiconductor lithography advances aiming to produce millions of high-performance AI accelerator chips.

items.title: @Polymarket: Executive Order Proposal Sparks Tech Industry Visa Debate
items.body: Corporate policy analysts and tech executives react to the proposed $103,265 H-1B visa application fee, assessing its potential impact on international talent recruitment.

items.title: @HooverInst: US-China Economic & Technology Strategy Analysis
items.body: The Hoover Institution published strategic review papers analyzing trade policies, technology export controls, and bilateral relations between the US and China.

items.title: @AlphaSenseInc: AlphaSense Launches SuperAnalyst AI Agent
